mapper.update: INSERT INTO chat_notification_settings (user_id, channel_id, notify_level, mute_until, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{channelId}, #{notifyLevel}, #{muteUntil}, now()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, channel_id) DO UPDATE SET notify_level = EXCLUDED.notify_level, mute_until = EXCLUDED.mute_until, updated_at = now()
